foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat state filing fee of $200.00 for the Certificate of Registration; certified copies ($50) and expedited services cost extra.
foreignQualification.formName: Certificate of Registration of Foreign Limited Liability Company
foreignQualification.filedWith: Department of State, Division of Corporations
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: Annual taxes of $400 for the foreign LLC are due by June 1 of each year following the close of the calendar year in which its registration is filed.

evidence.quote: The fee to file the Registration Certificate is $ 200.
Certificate of Registration of Foreign Limited Liability Company
Delaware Division of Corporations 401 Federal Street – Suite 4 Dover, DE 19901
Annual Taxes in the amount of $400 for the foreign limited liability company are due by June 1 of each year following the close of the calendar year

notes: The cover letter on the form (rev. 8/2026) states the $200 fee, and the Division's fee schedule revised August 1, 2026 lists Foreign Certificate of Registration at $200.00. The $400 annual tax is not part of the registration fee; certified copies ($50) and expedited services are additional.
